title: InferenceEngineRecord (card)
description: Canonical per-artifact model card. REVISED 2026-09-08 ~01:15 in place (never implemented, so no migration): aligned to the REAL card shape the probe machinery writes on .24 (model_cards/*.json, 00:39) instead of the aspirational nesting. This is the contract the store implements.
$comment: DOCTRINE (locked): (1) DIGEST IS THE KEY — a record is true only for the exact artifact; tags/names are aliases that re-point. (2) FACTS ONLY — native boundary behavior is recorded; the loaded discernment standard is occupant-owned and applied by the router on top, never stored here (04:16). (3) NO ROUTING FIELDS — no allowed/denied content, no policy, no occupant values. (4) NO RUNTIME STATE — liveness/residency/load are snapshots from the live system, never stored as registry truth. (5) dialect_class (standard/thinking/hazardous_template/unknown) is DERIVED from dialect fields at read time, never stored, so it can't go stale.

model.description: The ollama/model tag (e.g. 'muse-glimmer-30b-ablit:q4'). DISPLAY identity only — never the key. The digest is the key.

family.description: Model family, e.g. 'qwen2.5', 'muse-glimmer', 'gpt-oss-20b-moe'. Grouping axis for the selector.

digest.description: THE KEY. sha256 of the exact artifact (full 64-hex preferred; unambiguous prefix acceptable while unverified). New artifact = new digest = old behavioral notes suspect for the new burn.

aliases.description: Every tag/name that points at THIS artifact, with pointer history. last_seen: null means the CURRENT pointer (tag resolves here today). When ':latest' or another tag re-points to a new artifact: set last_seen on this record's alias, add the alias to the new record. Old records keep their notes — they remain true for that burn, just no longer current. Answers 'what is actually behind :latest right now?'

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 UTC, or null = current pointer.

base_identity.description: Seeded from /api/tags or ollama manifest at first contact.

source.description: HF repo / ollama library / local burn label.

dialect.description: THE critical half: how to talk to THIS model. Written by probes, never assumed.

template_dependent.description: True if it needs its chat template applied (Muse, many natives); raw /api/generate prompts produce garbage.

raw_output_markers.description: Template-native tokens that leak into raw output, e.g. ['<|message|>', '<|eot|>'].

peg_parser_hazard.description: True if output can 500 a naive parser (Glimmer vs ollama PEG).

content_only.description: True = clean content-only response (STANDARD class). False = has separate thinking/reasoning. THE probe-written discriminator.

tuning.description: Sane-config knowledge — accumulated 'right way to run it' lessons.

boundary_profile.description: NATIVE behavior facts (only). Refusal residuals, spec-negotiation, voice mirroring, abliteration state. Feeds 'which models can faithfully APPLY the loaded standard' — but the standard itself is occupant-owned, never here.

clamp_profile.description: B16 (2026-09-08): clamp/boundary behavior as ROUTING FACT for EVERY model any DeepGravity instance touches — stock Joe models included (Mrs. Grundy clamps are facts, not moral findings). Empty until probed (no telepathy). The battery's boundary pass produces these; routing consumes; the loaded standard is occupant-owned and applied on top (04:16).

disposition.description: How much clamping circuitry is present.

trigger_classes.description: Observed trigger categories (e.g. 'identity', 'taboo_sexual'). PROBED — never assumed.

manifestation.description: How the clamp shows up when triggered.

line_shift_by_frame.description: Does framing/register move the line? (Glimmer: yes — mirrors the frame.)

exposes_trigger_event.description: Does it reveal its own clamping circuitry (e.g. spec-negotiation in thinking field)?

behavioral_notes.description: ACCRUED BY USE, keyed to the digest. Never assumed; observed. Every probe that reveals something appends here (write-through).
